class.name: NetwQuantizeTransform2D
class.brief_description: [NetwQuantize] for a [Transform2D], with one quantizer for each part.
class.description: Compresses the origin, rotation and, when [member scale_quantizer] is set, scale. Skew is lost. An unset origin or rotation quantizer uses a default one. [codeblock] var q := NetwQuantizeTransform2D.new() q.origin_quantizer = NetwQuantizeScalar.new() q.rotation_quantizer = NetwQuantizeAngle.new() [/codeblock]

members.member: Quantizer for [member Transform2D.origin]. When [code]null[/code], a [NetwQuantizeScalar] from [code]-2048[/code] to [code]2048[/code] with a step of [code]0.5[/code] is used.
Quantizer for [method Transform2D.get_rotation]. When [code]null[/code], a default [NetwQuantizeAngle] is used.
Quantizer for [method Transform2D.get_scale]. When [code]null[/code], the scale is not sent and is [code]1[/code].
